notes.title: Last Egg Update!
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the last egg in the church, hidden near the plant in the corner, couldn't be picked up. Thanks to everyone who reported it!

notes.title: Hoppy Update!
notes.content:
We’ve been busy behind the scenes tidying things up like a bunch of hardworking Easter bunnies!
Here’s what’s new in this egg-citing update:

🛠️ Fixed some sneaky little bugs that were hiding better than the eggs!

🧺 Gave the Main Menu a fresh new look — now it’s shinier, smoother, and ready for adventure!

🐣 Overall, the game is hoppier and happier than ever!

Thanks for playing and keep hunting those eggs — who knows what surprises you’ll find next?
